name: AnimationMenu
author: ReAnimator
description: Play your .rska clips from the menu: a list in the PLUGINS section with per-clip ik and mask settings, and Ctrl+K for a grid of every clip with a stick figure of its pose. Needs ReSkate 2.1.3-reanim1 or later (the ReAnimator build): it uses plugin bindings that stock ReSkate does not have.
